properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token validity in milliseconds (default: 86400000 = 24 h).

properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the frontend app (used in email links).

properties.name: app.backend-url
properties.description: Base URL of the backend API (used in email links).

properties.name: openai.api-key
properties.description: OpenAI API key for AI assistant features.
